title: IP sales rankings
scope_note: No all-channel, China-only ranking of every blind-box or squishy IP has been verified. These are separate, dated comparisons. Never combine their ranks, periods or metrics.

china618.label: China Advertising Association Cultural Creative & IP Committee: 2026 Tmall 618 platform ranking
china618.source_type: Industry association publication of platform figures
china618.metric: Paid merchandise value (GMV), as defined in the published list
china618.scope: Related IP merchandise across categories, not blind boxes alone. The source mixes individual IPs, IP portfolios and the POP MART brand. Published order is preserved; monetary amounts and unit totals are not supplied. The source notes that entries may be substituted when a place is vacant.

popmartH1.label: POP MART 2026 Interim Report, printed page 25; regional context on page 16
popmartH1.source_type: Company interim report; unaudited financial period
popmartH1.scope: Rank among the eight individually disclosed artist-IP rows, not all Chinese IPs and not China-only sales. Other artist IPs and licensed IPs are aggregated, not individually ranked. The revenue includes product formats beyond blind boxes. THE MONSTERS includes LABUBU; it is not LABUBU-only revenue.

q3.label: Sanwenyu / Wenchao: Q3 2026 review of Tmall and Douyin blind-box charts
q3.market: China · Tmall and Douyin observed charts
q3.scope: Seven named series meet the reported threshold. They are not ordered by sales. The underlying purchase-counter periods, cancellations, returns and variant aggregation are not verified; the counts are not audited Q3 units. Limited releases and products outside the observed charts can be missing.

yoyo.label: MINISO business update, 9 October 2026
yoyo.source_type: Company statement based on preliminary operational data; not auditor reviewed
yoyo.metric: Global IP GMV above RMB1 billion
yoyo.scope: GMV is not company revenue or units sold. Nine-month data must not be ranked against six-month POP MART revenue or a one-month China-platform campaign.

squishy.label: Heartfelt: retailer-curated hot / social-media collection
squishy.source_type: Specialist retailer curation, not a sales panel
squishy.scope: Useful for discovery, not a national best-seller ranking. Each product keeps its own observed date and explanation. No ordinal sales rank is assigned.

molynk.label: Molynk official FAQ
molynk.market: China and overseas; no comparable sales panel
molynk.scope: Official product context, not independent popularity proof or a comparable ranking. Ambiguous sales statements are not converted into currency, units or a rank.

china_channels: Official mainland brand stores and release announcements
maintenance: Review sources weekly, but only update a ranking's figures and reporting period when a new comparable source is available. Preserve earlier snapshots. Never convert global revenue into China-only sales or divide revenue by a toy price to invent units. A product count measures catalog capture, not market share. Reconcile full named assortments and exact images before labeling a brand complete.
